entries.rationale: Ported with four designed-out cases (owner decision, 2026-09-29, Michael Kinsy; listed in designedOutCases, which the gate checks against the inventory): the four shouldRunFirstTimeSetup cases (:36 true for experimental/default directory/missing settings, :40 false without experimental features, :46 false with a custom directory, :52 false with existing settings) are designed out. Pi runs first-time setup only for its official distribution identity (src/cli/startup-ui.ts:122-140 requires package @earendil-works/pi-coding-agent, app pi and .pi config directory); the caller is src/main.ts:661, which gates showFirstTimeSetup. PiG is never Pi's official distribution, so the only possible port was a fabricated test-only identity, which review rejected (a test-only implementation with no production path does not close a hot-path upstream test). PORT_MAP already designs out the official-only first-time-setup component. No onboarding behavior or fake official identity is added. The remaining four analytics cases are ported and their evidence is verified by the gate, with their original assertions and source citations: disabled/no ID (:60), opt-in UUID (:67), opt-out/no ID (:76), and stable ID across toggles (:85). Both the original in-memory manager and supplemental file-backed manager pass on Linux with Go 1.27.1 and -count=1; a compiling mutation that regenerates the ID on every opt-in fails the toggle case in both managers. The real CLI fork test TestFirstTimeSetupOriginalCasesAsFork keeps the four original input combinations and asserts real Pi's non-official-distribution result (setup never shown); it is supplemental fork evidence, not a port of the official-distribution expectations.
